'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels capture the towns of Kiwanja and [[Rutshuru]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. In response, the Congolese government expels [[Rwanda]]'s ambassador, accusing the country of supporting the rebels. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/30/dr-congo-expels-rwandan-ambassador-as-m23-rebels-gain-ground (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Five [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are injured during a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] at a checkpoint in [[Jericho]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. The perpetrator is shot dead by [[Israel Police|police]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2022-10-30/ty-article/four-israelis-wounded-in-suspected-west-bank-car-ramming-attack/00000184-28e6-dd06-a59d-6de731c70000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Morbi bridge collapse]]
**At least 141 people are killed in a [[bridge collapse|collapse of a bridge]] over the [[Machchhu River]] in [[Morbi]], [[Gujarat]], India. More than 80 people have been rescued. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/morbi-gujarat-bridge-collapse-live-updates-october-30-2022/article66075016.ece (The Hindu)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-asia-india-63452531 (BBC News)]
*Eleven people are killed during a [[Crowd collapses and crushes|crowd crush]] at a [[Fally Ipupa]] concert at the [[Stade des Martyrs]] in [[Kinshasa]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]].  [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/overcrowded-stadium-crush-kills-11-people-congolese-capital-2022-10-30/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Russia]] announces sanctions on eleven [[British Overseas Territories]], accusing them of "unfriendly actions" against Moscow. With these sanctions, the [[United Kingdom]] and all 14 British Overseas Territories are now on Russia's [[Unfriendly Countries List|list of sanctioned territories]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-adds-11-remaining-british-overseas-territories-to-sanctions-list/2724751 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Dover firebomb attack]]
**A man throws firebombs at a centre for processing [[asylum seeker]]s in [[Dover]], [[Kent]], [[UK]], injuring two people before killing himself. [https://www.thejournal.ie/uk-asylum-office-firebombed-5907107-Oct2022/ (TheJournal.ie)]
*[[Crime in London]]
**Two people are shot and killed in [[Brixton]], [[London]], while a bystander was knocked down and injured by the gunman's vehicle. No arrests have been made. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-63451427 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Brazilian general election]]
**[[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] narrowly wins election to [[Brazil]]'s [[President of Brazil|presidency]] with 50.9% of the vote, defeating incumbent [[Jair Bolsonaro]] in the second-round run-off. [https://time.com/6226302/lula-wins-brazil-election-defeats-bolsonaro/ (''Time'')] [https://news.sky.com/story/brazil-goes-to-the-polls-to-decide-between-jair-bolsonaro-and-lula-da-silva-12733900 (Sky News)]
